original_test_intent: Drive the intended UID indicator through Blue steady On, Blue 1 Hz blink and Off states using the platform control path, visually verify each state, and restore Off.
original_method: Confirm SUT/BMC and exact raw-command byte semantics; record initial UID state; issue each approved command once in order; capture exit/readback plus SUT-linked video sufficient to measure color and cadence; verify Off restoration and logs. Do not substitute chassis-identify or Redfish unless equivalence to all three source states is approved.
manual_activity: Operator visually confirms Blue steady/blink/Off and safe final state; agent may send approved commands and analyze timestamped evidence.
required_inputs: BMC/board firmware and exact netfn/cmd/data semantics
UID LED designator and mapping to front/rear indicators
Expected Blue chromatic state, 1 Hz tolerance/duty and settle/observe windows
Approved readback and whether standard IPMI/Redfish controls are exactly equivalent
safety_requirements: Verify target and command bytes before sending state changes
Capture initial state and restore Off even after intermediate failure
Rate-limit one ordered transition per state and never retry blindly
Use safe physical observation and preserve command/log evidence
agent_execution_scope: Issue only owner-approved UID state commands and capture status/readback
Analyze provided video for color/cadence and correlate logs
Do not infer visual state, substitute APIs, leave LED On/blinking, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve raw byte meanings and interface equivalence
Approve indicator map, color/cadence tolerance and readback
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic `chassis identify` may support On/Off or timed identify but does not automatically prove the source's raw 1 Hz Blue mode; equivalence is pending.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact approved raw sequences or a formally mapped equivalent, one state at a time, with readback and physical video.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three source byte sequences and Blue/1 Hz/Off expectations remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a three-state evidence table binding command bytes, BMC response/readback and timestamped physical color/cadence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds semantic verification, exact visual tolerances, target identity and fail-safe Off restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A software IndicatorLED value cannot prove actual Blue output or 1 Hz optical cadence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw commands are platform-specific and may control a different LED or timer on another firmware; visual sampling can alias blink rate.

project_override_considerations: If front and rear UID LEDs are separate, enumerate both if required by the hardware spec. An approved Redfish mapping may supplement but not silently replace the exact raw-command coverage.
expected_evidence: SUT-linked video/photo proving Blue steady, measured 1 Hz blink and Off
Final Off/readback, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria align exactly on the three raw-command LED states; missing platform semantics/tolerances are pending inputs, not contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The hybrid case is conditionally executable with approved command mapping and physical observation.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2263 Wistron-HW-00374-V004: approve BMC/board firmware and exact semantics of raw sequences `0x00 0x04 0 0x01`, `0x00 0x04 0x0f 0`, and `0x00 0x04 0 0`; map controlled front/rear UID indicators; define Blue color and 1 Hz frequency/duty tolerances, settle/observation window and readback; decide whether chassis-identify or Redfish is exactly equivalent; approve one-shot ordering and guaranteed final Off restoration.

review_improvement: Keeps the exact three-state coverage while preventing an unsupported API substitution and making physical color/cadence evidence measurable.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPMI raw bytes are implementation-specific even when they resemble a standard chassis identify command, and parameter encodings for forced versus timed/blinking states vary. A successful completion code only confirms command processing, not the optical output. The test therefore needs firmware-bound byte semantics, physical indicator mapping, measurable video and a fail-safe Off transition; standard-interface substitution requires explicit equivalence for the 1 Hz Blue state.
